title: S1 Competitor Snapshot (scrapling-output-mapping §14.2)
description: Per-row sub-schema for weekly competitor monitoring (S1). Each row in the staging table represents one competitor URL fetched on a given snapshot_date. Fields cover snapshot identity (snapshot_date + domain + url_normalized), fetch metadata (fetch_method, tier_attempts, fetch_duration_ms, status_code), and content (content_hash, content_excerpt ≤500 char, meta_title, meta_description, h1, schema_org_count, page_size_bytes). url_normalized follows the D-03 cross-sheet invariant (lowercase scheme+host, strip trailing slash on non-root, drop fragment, drop tracking params, sort remaining query keys). The fetch_method enum mirrors the §14.5 tier_escalation invariant `['get','fetch','stealthy_fetch']` exactly — extending or reordering is a schema violation. ADR-025 Phase 7+ activation: this is the first concrete sub-schema landed under templates/scrapling/.

snapshot_date.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the snapshot. Microsecond precision recommended; same fetched_at value shared across rows of one batch.

domain.description: Competitor root domain (no scheme, no trailing slash, no www. unless meaningful). Sourced from the DFS competitors_domain response.

url_normalized.description: D-03 canonical URL form. Idempotent under normalize_url; used as the cross-skill join key.

url_original.description: URL as fetched, before normalization. Kept for drift recovery + debugging.

fetch_method.description: Tier that succeeded (§14.5). Order is canonical (cheap → expensive); first-success short-circuits the ladder.

tier_attempts.description: Number of tiers attempted before success (1 = get only, 2 = get+fetch, 3 = all three).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical body content (UTF-8). Lowercase hex, no `sha256:` prefix on this sub-schema (raw 64-char hex per the brief).

content_excerpt.description: First 500 chars of the cleaned body for diff visibility. Truncated, not summarised.

meta_title.description: Page <title> element text, trimmed. Null when absent.

h1.description: All H1 heading texts, document order preserved. Empty array when none.

schema_org_count.description: Count of JSON-LD schema.org instances found on the page (script[type=application/ld+json] blocks).

page_size_bytes.description: Raw response body byte count (UTF-8 encoded length when content is text).

status_code.description: HTTP status code from the successful tier (or last-attempted tier for failure rows the orchestrator decides to keep).

fetch_duration_ms.description: End-to-end fetch wall time in milliseconds (sum across attempted tiers).
